LESSON: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION IN KENYA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Social Organisations
Topic 2.2: Population distribution in Kenya

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Population distribution in Kenya
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is population distribution useful in Kenya?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya
2. show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map

Teach
• Today’s focus: show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map” using a school example.
• Model B for “show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya
• Model 2: show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya
2. Practise: show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Population distribution in Kenya.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is population distribution useful in Kenya?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya
• show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
